origin.label: Hudson Yards, Manhattan
origin.reason: A recognizable west-side starting point. The drive to The Met crosses Midtown and the Upper West Side, long enough to show parked, driving and arrival.

visit.reason: The Met Fifth Avenue is closed on Wednesdays, so the plan made on Wednesday is for Thursday afternoon.

weather.dayForecast: Mostly cloudy, a chance of showers after 7 AM (30%); high near 74°F, around 71°F in the afternoon; south wind 6 to 12 mph
weather.reason: A mild, mostly cloudy Thursday with a chance of showers: the museum is a good indoor plan, and a compact umbrella is worth packing for the walk in.

commerce.reason: Timed entry appears as a DEMO ticket. No reservation is made with The Met and nothing is paid, so no merchant, real or fictional, is involved.

freshness.policy: Show the forecast day and source; never relabel this fixture as live weather, live location, availability or a confirmed reservation.
